description: Capability for the sniffer child webview opened by browser-sniffer-tauri-rust. Grants only the event bus (so the injected bootstrap can emit BrowserSnifferBridge.webToHost tags as bridge:{tag} Tauri events, and listen for the host's bridge:Click / bridge:CancelSnifferRequest sends) and log access (so console mirroring works the same way it does in the main webview). The broad core:default surface is intentionally NOT granted — the third-party page loaded into this webview shares the JS context with our bootstrap and inherits whatever __TAURI__ namespace permissions allow.
